.. change::
    :tags: feature, ops

    Added :func:`.analyze_ops`, a read-only reporting interface in the new
    :mod:`alembic.operations.risk` module.  Given an :class:`.UpgradeOps` or
    :class:`.DowngradeOps` object, it walks the operation tree (including
    nested :class:`.ModifyTableOps`) and reports table drops, column drops,
    string length shortening and nullable-to-not-nullable column changes
    without executing or mutating the operations.  Records that cannot be
    decided from the operation object alone, such as a missing
    ``existing_type`` or ``existing_nullable``, are marked as "无法判断"
    instead of being guessed from database state.  The report is advisory
    only; the operation tree and generated SQL are unchanged.
